ST-Standard GM-07 Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset (50mm High-Output Drivers / Noise-Reduction Flexible Mic / Dynamic RGB Lighting / Heavy Duty USB Cable / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Experience immersive game audio and accurate spatial sound positioning with the ST-Standard GM-07 Virtual 7.1 Surround Sound RGB Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Driven by tuned 50mm dynamic speaker units, this headset delivers crisp highs, rich mid-tones, and deep resonant bass for extended competitive gaming sessions. Built with an ultra-lightweight suspension headband frame and plush memory foam leatherette ear pads, it ensures exceptional passive noise isolation while reducing clamping pressure on your head. The GM-07 incorporates an adjustable omnidirectional microphone featuring noise-reduction technology to guarantee clear team communication during match play. Outfitted with eye-catching dynamic RGB accent lighting and connected via a robust USB cable, this plug-and-play headset is ready for all desktop and laptop gaming setups.
